Metadata.title: Coffee journal
Metadata.description: Your future coffee journal: bags of beans, brews, tasting notes and what’s left.

Home.title: Coffee worth
Home.description: Your favourite beans, memorable brews and notes from every cup, all in one place.
Home.journalTitle: From the first bean to the last cup.
Home.journalDescription: We’re building a journal to help you notice the flavour and find your favourite combinations.
Home.beansDescription: Keep track of bags, roasters and dates. Remember which coffees you’d love to try again.
Home.brewsDescription: Record your method, dose and tasting notes. Rate each brew from 1 to 10.
Home.stockDescription: Track your beans after each brew and adjust the remaining amount whenever you need to.
Home.footerAffiliation: and is not affiliated with Tasty Coffee
Home.statusShort: A coffee journal in the making
Home.ritualDescription: A morning coffee at home or a slow cup on the weekend. Your journal will help you keep the little things that make your coffee special.
Home.ritualAlt: Coffee and a croissant on a wooden table beside an open book
Home.flavourDescription: What did you like about the beans? How did the flavour change? A few words after brewing will help you find the answer and make that favourite cup again.
Home.flavourAlt: Iced coffee in a tall glass with milk and ice cubes
